description: Registrar General's Department - Registration of Deaths (Temporary Provision) Act, No. 19 of 2010, will be extended another Five Years from 09th December 2023 to 09th December 2028
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Dinesh Gunawardana) with his official titles (Prime Minister and Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government) AND outlines detailed regulatory responsibilities (extending the operation period of the Registration of Deaths Act). This combination of named personnel and specific portfolio responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
